# Zeus Garage Doors

> Professional garage door repair, spring replacement, cable repair, opener installation, and new door installation. Serving Kirkland, Bellevue, Redmond, Mercer Island, Bothell, Woodinville, Kenmore, Lynnwood, and the greater Seattle Eastside in Washington State. Emergency service available Sunday through Thursday evenings. 5-year warranty on all parts and labor.

## Services

### Spring Replacement
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/spring-replacement
Torsion and extension spring replacement for all residential garage doors. Correct spring sizing calculated on-site based on door weight. High-cycle springs rated to 20,000+ cycles available. 5-year parts and labor warranty. Same-day service across the Eastside.

### Opener Repair and Installation
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/opener-repair
Repair and installation of all major opener brands. Authorized LiftMaster dealer. Belt-drive, chain-drive, and jackshaft (wall-mount) opener installation. myQ smart home integration. 5-year parts and labor warranty.

### Cable Replacement
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/cable-replacement
Lift cable inspection and replacement. Cables are replaced in pairs. Spring tension released safely before cable work. 5-year warranty on all cable repairs.

### Off-Track Repair
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/off-track-repair
Garage door derailed from tracks is an unstable heavy object. Professional realignment and root cause repair. Track adjustment, roller replacement, and hardware inspection included.

### Panel Replacement
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/panel-replacement
Individual panel replacement for dented or damaged sections. Full door replacement evaluation provided if damage is extensive. Steel, aluminum, and composite panels.

### New Door Installation
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/new-installation
Full residential garage door installation. Steel, insulated steel, aluminum, composite, and wood options. Single-car and two-car openings. Non-standard sizes accommodated.

### Roller Replacement
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/roller-replacement
Steel and nylon roller replacement. Nylon rollers (10,000-cycle rated) eliminate grinding noise permanently. Included in tune-up or done as standalone repair.

### Sensor Repair
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/sensor-repair
Photoelectric safety sensor alignment, wiring repair, and replacement. Required by federal law on all openers manufactured after 1993.

### Garage Door Tune-Up
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/garage-door-tune-up
Full-system inspection and lubrication. Includes hardware tightening, auto-reverse safety test, balance test, roller and hinge inspection, and spring tension check.

### Weather Seal Replacement
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/weather-seal-replacement
Bottom seal, side seal, and top seal replacement. Critical for energy efficiency and keeping Pacific Northwest rain, drafts, and pests out.

### Track Repair
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/track-repair
Bent, misaligned, or damaged track realignment and replacement. Tracks are the most common secondary damage after an off-track door event.

### Safety Inspection
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/safety-inspection
Comprehensive 21-point safety and mechanical inspection. UL 325 auto-reverse test, spring tension check, cable condition, hardware torque, and sensor alignment.

### Remote & Keypad Programming
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/remote-keypad-programming
Programming and reprogramming of all remote types, HomeLink, and wireless keypads for LiftMaster, Chamberlain, Genie, and other brands.

### Manual to Automatic Conversion
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/manual-to-automatic-conversion
Install a motorized opener on a previously manual door. Includes opener selection, mounting, spring tension check, and sensor installation.

### Noise Reduction
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/services/noise-reduction
Nylon roller upgrade, hinge lubrication, anti-vibration isolation kit installation. Most noisy-door complaints resolved without full door replacement.

### Emergency Garage Door Repair
URL: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/emergency-garage-door-repair
Same-night emergency dispatch available Sunday through Thursday evenings. Covers broken springs, snapped cables, doors stuck open, and doors off-track. Not available Friday or Saturday nights.

## Blog — Educational Guides

### Springs
- How Long Do Garage Door Springs Last in Washington State?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/how-long-do-garage-door-springs-last
  Standard torsion springs rated 10,000–15,000 cycles. High-cycle springs rated 20,000+. WA humidity shortens lifespan by 20–30% without lubrication.
- Factors That Affect Garage Door Spring Replacement Costs: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/spring-replacement-cost-factors
  Cost factors: spring type, door weight, standard vs high-cycle, single vs dual system, climate upgrades, and scheduling timing.

### Openers
- LiftMaster vs Chamberlain Garage Door Opener — What's the Real Difference?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/liftmaster-vs-chamberlain-garage-door-opener
  Both owned by The Chamberlain Group. LiftMaster is the professional dealer brand; Chamberlain is the consumer retail brand. Zeus installs LiftMaster exclusively.
- Best Garage Door Opener for Pacific Northwest Weather (LiftMaster vs Genie): https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/best-garage-door-opener-pnw
  Belt-drive openers recommended for PNW humidity. LiftMaster vs Genie comparison for Eastside WA homeowners.

### Safety and DIY
- Is DIY Garage Door Repair Safe? The Honest Answer: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/is-diy-garage-door-repair-safe
  Safe DIY: lubrication, remote batteries, limit settings, hardware tightening, weather stripping. Dangerous: torsion spring replacement (150–400 lbs stored force), cable replacement, off-track repair.
- Garage Door Maintenance Checklist: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/garage-door-maintenance-checklist
  Bi-annual service routine: lubrication, hardware tightening, auto-reverse test, balance test, weatherstrip inspection, roller inspection.

### Troubleshooting
- Why Is My Garage Door Opening by Itself?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/garage-door-opens-by-itself
  Common causes: wiring shorts, misaligned safety sensors, radio frequency interference, duplicate remote codes.
- Why Won't My Garage Door Close All the Way?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/why-wont-garage-door-close-all-the-way
  Causes: misaligned safety sensors, down-limit setting too high, obstruction in track, damaged bottom seal.
- Why Is My Garage Door So Noisy?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/why-is-my-garage-door-so-noisy
  Causes by noise type: rattling (loose hardware), grinding (worn rollers), squeaking (dry hinges), banging (loose chain or torsion spring).
- Garage Door Won't Open in Cold Weather — 7 Common Causes: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/garage-door-wont-open-cold-weather
  Cold-weather failures: frozen bottom seal, contracted springs, thickened grease, battery drain, disconnected trolley, photo-eye misalignment, opener sensitivity.
- What Causes a Garage Door to Come Off Track?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/what-causes-garage-door-off-track
  Causes: impact damage, worn/broken rollers, misaligned tracks, broken cable, seized bottom bracket.
- How Long Do Garage Door Cables Last?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/how-long-do-garage-door-cables-last
  Typical lifespan 7–12 years. Failure modes: fraying, corrosion, bottom bracket failure, spring break shock load.
- Nylon vs Steel Garage Door Rollers — Which Is Better?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/nylon-vs-steel-garage-door-rollers
  Nylon: quieter, no lubrication, 10,000+ cycle rating. Steel: cheaper upfront but loud and wears faster. Nylon recommended for daily-use residential doors.
- How to Program a Garage Door Remote, HomeLink & Keypad: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/how-to-program-garage-door-remote
  Step-by-step for rolling code openers: press Learn button on motor unit, press remote button, confirm flash. HomeLink programming also covered.

### Pricing Guides
- How Much Does a Garage Door Service Call Cost?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/garage-door-service-call-cost
  Cost depends on what broke, door weight, system age, secondary findings, and scheduling (standard vs emergency). Zeus quotes flat-rate on-site only.
- What's the Average Cost to Replace a Garage Door in 2026?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/average-cost-to-replace-garage-door
  Cost driven by material (steel/aluminum/wood), insulation R-value, door size, opener type. Zeus quotes on-site only — no phone quotes.

### Buying Decisions
- Repair vs Replace Garage Door — How to Decide: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/repair-vs-replace-garage-door
  Repair: one panel damaged, mechanical issue on newer door. Replace: 15+ years old, multiple sections damaged, frequent breakdowns, major curb appeal upgrade.
- Chain vs Belt vs Jackshaft Opener — Which Drive System Is Right for You?: https://zeusgaragedoorswa.com/blog/chain-vs-belt-vs-jackshaft-opener
  Chain: loudest, lowest cost, best for detached garages. Belt: quiet, ideal for attached garages. Jackshaft: ceiling-mount, works for low-clearance or high-lift doors.
